{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders only
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Identify QA orders: revenue = 999999.99
qa_mask = df_completed['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
num_qa = qa_mask.sum()
print(f'Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {num_qa}')

# Compute mean revenue of ALL completed orders (including QA)
mean_revenue_inclusive = df_completed['revenue_clean'].mean()
print(f'Mean revenue of completed orders (including QA): {mean_revenue_inclusive}')"}
